questions.stem: A rectangle is formed by the lines $x = 0$, $y = 0$, $x = 3$ and $y = 4$. Let the line L be perpendicular to $3x + y + 6 = 0$ and divide the area of the rectangle into two equal parts. Then the distance of the point $\left(\frac{1}{2}, -5\right)$ from the line L is equal to :
questions.solution:
Equation of L is $y = \frac{1}{3}x + \lambda$
line L will pass through intersection point of daigonal beacuse line L divide the area of the rectanlge into two equal parts
L passes through $\left(\frac{3}{2}, 2\right)$
$2 = \frac{1}{2} + \lambda$
$\lambda = \frac{3}{2}$
$\frac{1}{3}x - y + \frac{3}{2} = 0$
distance from $\left(\frac{1}{2}, -5\right)$
$$\left|\frac{\frac{1}{6} + 5 + \frac{3}{2}}{\sqrt{\frac{1}{9} + 1}}\right| = \frac{\frac{40}{6}}{\frac{\sqrt{10}}{3}} = 2\sqrt{10}$$

questions.stem: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ respectively be the maximum and the minimum values of the function $f(\theta) = 4\left(\sin^{4}\left(\frac{7\pi}{2} - \theta\right) + \sin^{4}(11\pi + \theta)\right) - 2\left(\sin^{6}\left(\frac{3\pi}{2} - \theta\right) + \sin^{6}(9\pi - \theta)\right), \theta \in R$. Then $\alpha + 2\beta$ is equal to :

Let $\vec{a} = -\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 2\hat{k}$, $\vec{b} = \hat{i} - \hat{j} - 3\hat{k}$, $\vec{c} = \vec{a} \times \vec{b}$ and $\vec{d} = \vec{c} \times \vec{a}$. Then $(\vec{a} - \vec{b}) \cdot \vec{d}$ is equal to :
questions.solution:
Method -I
$\vec{c} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ -1 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & -1 & -3 \end{vmatrix}$ ; $\vec{d} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ -1 & -1 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix}$
$\vec{c} = -\hat{i} - \hat{j}$ ; $\vec{d} = -2\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}$
$\vec{a} - \vec{b} = -2\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}$
$(\vec{a} - \vec{b}) \cdot \vec{d} = 4 + 4 - 10$
$= -2$
Method -II
$\vec{c} \perp^{r} \vec{a}$ ; $\vec{d} \perp^{r} \vec{a}$
$\vec{c} \perp^{r} \vec{b}$ and $\vec{d} \perp^{r} \vec{c}$
So $\vec{d}$ lies in plane of $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ and perpenducular to $\vec{a}$
$\vec{d} = \left(\vec{a} \times \vec{b}\right) \times \vec{a}$
$\vec{d} = |\vec{a}|^{2}\vec{b} - \left(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}\right)\vec{a}$
$\vec{d} = 6\vec{b} + 8\vec{a}$
$\left(\vec{a} - \vec{b}\right) \cdot \vec{d} = \left(\vec{a} - \vec{b}\right) \cdot \left(6\vec{b} + 8\vec{a}\right)$
$= 8|\vec{a}|^{2} - 6|\vec{b}|^{2} - 2\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}$
$= 48 - 66 + 16 = -2$

questions.stem: A building construction work can be completed by two masons A and B together in $22.5$ days. Mason A alone can complete the construction work in $24$ days less than mason B alone. Then mason A alone will complete the construction work in :
questions.solution:
Let time taken by mason A alone to complete the work be in $x$ days so, mason B along take $x + 24$ days
work done by A in one day $= \frac{1}{x}$
work done by B in one day $= \frac{1}{x + 24}$
So work done by A + B in one day $= \frac{1}{22.5}$
$\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{x + 24} = \frac{1}{22.5}$
$x^{2} - 21x - 540 = 0$
$x = 36$ or $x = -15$ (Rej.)
$x = 36$

questions.stem: Let $f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{ax^{2} + 2ax + 3}{4x^{2} + 4x - 3}, & x \neq -\frac{3}{2}, \frac{1}{2} \\ b, & x = -\frac{3}{2}, \frac{1}{2} \end{cases}$ be continuous at $x = -\frac{3}{2}$. If $fof(x) = \frac{7}{5}$, then $x$ is equal to :
questions.solution:
$$\lim_{x \to \frac{-3}{2}} \frac{ax^{2} + 2ax + 3}{(2x - 1)(2x + 3)}$$
{at $x = -\frac{3}{2}$ denominator is zero so numerator should be zero}
$a\left(-\frac{3}{2}\right)^{2} + 2a\left(-\frac{3}{2}\right) + 3 = 0$
$\frac{3a}{4} = 3 \Rightarrow a = 4$
$$f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{(2x + 1)(2x + 3)}{(2x - 1)(2x + 3)} & x \neq \frac{-3}{2}, \frac{1}{2} \\ b & x = \frac{-3}{2}, \frac{1}{2} \end{cases}$$
$$f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{2x + 1}{2x - 1} & x \neq \frac{-3}{2}, \frac{1}{2} \\ b & x = \frac{-3}{2}, \frac{1}{2} \end{cases}$$
$$f(f(x)) = f\left(\frac{2x + 1}{2x - 1}\right) = \frac{2\left(\frac{2x + 1}{2x - 1}\right) + 1}{2\left(\frac{2x + 1}{2x - 1}\right) - 1} = \frac{7}{5}$$
$x = 1$

Let the hyperbola $\frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}} - \frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}} = 1$ have eccentricity $\frac{n}{3}$ and the length of the latus rectum $\frac{8m}{3}$. Then $b^{2} - a^{2}$ is equal to :

Let $y = y(x)$ be the solution of the differential equation $x^{4}\,dy + \left(4x^{3}y + 2\sin x\right)dx = 0, x > 0, y\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 0$. Then $\pi^{4}y\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$ is equal to :
questions.solution:
$x^{4}dy + 4x^{3}y\,dx + 2\sin x\,dx = 0$
$\int\left(x^{4}dy + 4x^{3}y\,dx\right) + 2\int \sin x\,dx = 0$
$\int d\left(x^{4}y\right) = -2\int \sin x\,dx$
$x^{4}y = 2\cos x + C$ ; $f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 0$
$c = 0$
$f(x) = \frac{2\cos x}{x^{4}}$
$$f\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \frac{2 \times 1/2}{\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right)^{4}}$$
$\pi^{4}f\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = 81$

Let the line $y - x = 1$ intersect the ellipse $\frac{x^{2}}{2} + \frac{y^{2}}{1} = 1$ at the points A and B. Then the angle made by the line segment AB at the center of the ellipse is :

Among the statements :
I : If $\begin{vmatrix} 1 & \cos\alpha & \cos\beta \\ \cos\alpha & 1 & \cos\gamma \\ \cos\beta & \cos\gamma & 1 \end{vmatrix} = \begin{vmatrix} 0 & \cos\alpha & \cos\beta \\ \cos\alpha & 0 & \cos\gamma \\ \cos\beta & \cos\gamma & 0 \end{vmatrix}$, then $\cos^{2}\alpha + \cos^{2}\beta + \cos^{2}\gamma = \frac{3}{2}$ and
II : If $\begin{vmatrix} x^{2} + x & x + 1 & x - 2 \\ 2x^{2} + 3x - 1 & 3x & 3x - 3 \\ x^{2} + 2x + 3 & 2x - 1 & 2x - 1 \end{vmatrix} = px + q$ then $p^{2} = 196q^{2}$ :
questions.solution:
$1 - \cos^{2}\gamma - \cos\alpha\left(\cos\alpha - \cos\beta\cos\gamma\right) + \cos\beta\left(\cos\alpha\cos\gamma - \cos\beta\right)$
$= -\cos\alpha\left(0 - \cos\beta\cos\gamma\right) + \cos\beta\left(\cos\alpha\cos\gamma\right)$
$\Rightarrow 1 - \mathrm{con}^{2}\gamma - \cos^{2}\alpha + \cos\alpha\cos\beta\cos\gamma + \cos\alpha\cos\beta\cos\gamma - \cos^{2}\beta$
$= \cos\alpha\cos\beta\cos\gamma + \cos\alpha\cos\beta\cos\gamma$
$\Rightarrow \cos^{2}\alpha + \cos^{2}\beta + \cos^{2}\gamma = 1$
So, first statement is false
put $x = 0$ for q
$q = \begin{vmatrix} 0 & 1 & -2 \\ -1 & 0 & -3 \\ 3 & -1 & -1 \end{vmatrix}$
$q = -12$
put $x = 1$ for p
$p + q = \begin{vmatrix} 2 & 2 & -1 \\ 4 & 3 & 3 \\ 6 & 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix}$
$p = 54$
$p^{2} \neq 196q^{2}$
So second statement is also false.

questions.stem: Let $f(x) = \int \frac{\left(2 - x^{2}\right) \cdot e^{x}}{(\sqrt{1 + x})(1 - x)^{3/2}}\,dx$. If $f(0) = 0$, then $f\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)$ is equal to :
questions.solution:
$$f(x) = \int e^{x}\left(\frac{1 + 1 - x^{2}}{\sqrt{1 + x}(1 - x)^{3/2}}\right)dx$$
$$= \int e^{x}\left(\frac{1 - x^{2}}{\sqrt{1 + x}(1 - x)^{3/2}} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + x}(1 - x)^{3/2}}\right)dx$$
$$= \int e^{x}\left(\sqrt{\frac{1 + x}{1 - x}} + \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 + x}(1 - x)^{3/2}}\right)dx$$
$$= e^{x}\sqrt{\frac{1 + x}{1 - x}} + c \quad \left\{\because \int e^{x}\left(f(x) + f'(x)\right)dx\right\} = e^{x}f(x) + c$$
$f(0) = 0$
$c = -1$
$$f(x) = e^{x}\sqrt{\frac{1 + x}{1 - x}} - 1$$
$$\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = \sqrt{e}\sqrt{\frac{\frac{3}{2}}{\frac{1}{2}}} - 1$$
$$f\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = \sqrt{3e} - 1$$

Let $f$ be a twice differentiable non-negative function such that $(f(x))^{2} = 25 + \int_{0}^{x}\left((f(t))^{2} + \left(f'(t)\right)^{2}\right)dt$. Then the mean of $f\left(\log_{e}(1)\right), f\left(\log_{e}(2)\right), \ldots, f\left(\log_{e}(625)\right)$ is equal to ______.

From the first $100$ natural numbers, two numbers first $a$ and then $b$ are selected randomly without replacement. If the probability that $a - b \geq 10$ is $\frac{m}{n}$, $\gcd(m, n) = 1$, then $m + n$ is equal to ______.
questions.solution:
$a - b \geq 10$
If $a = 100$ than $b$ can be $\{1, 2, 3, \ldots, 90\}$
If $a = 99$ than $b$ can be $\{1, 2, \ldots, 89\}$
$\vdots$
If $a = 11$ than $b$ can be $\{1\}$
total favourable case $= 1 + 2 + 3 + \ldots + 90$
total case $= 100 \times 99$
$$\text{Reg. Probability} = \frac{\frac{90 \times 91}{2}}{100 \times 99}$$
$$= \frac{91}{220} = \frac{m}{n}$$
$m + n = 311$
